decisions: Stop at GATE-070 with PR #633 merge-ready and unmerged.
Land cleanup separately, then make main the PR base.
Keep exactly twelve operations in PR #633.
Treat topology.build as an explicit prerequisite for snapshot traversal and change planning.
Do not build topology inside change.plan.
Keep current broad graph algorithms internal to :topology:service.
Add topology.path, topology.condensation, and topology.quotient in separate pull requests.
Never add topology.cycles or a generic topology.query operation.

CanonicalOperationDefinitions is the only authority for installed operation IDs.
GenerateControlMetadataTask copies operation-registry.json from an @InputFile and does not reconstruct it.
The installed PR #633 operation set is exactly the twelve operation IDs declared by this program.
change.plan and traversal.run cannot receive topology construction or publication authority; the snapshot router cannot receive the combined topology store.
Missing or stale topology is distinct from a stale selector and from bounded traversal incompleteness.
A traversal bound produces Qualified, never Complete absence.
Only complete topology coverage can advance the published snapshot.
A current topology snapshot remains usable after indexer restart without a K2 call on the traversal route.
The stable :topology:contract API contains no zero-budget graph algorithm method.
No public topology.cycles or generic topology.query operation exists.
Every gate report is bound to the program fingerprint and exact repository head.
PR #633 merges only after exact-head CI passes the complete merge-candidate gate.

tasks.title: Land the cleanup branch on current main
tasks.scope: Open a cleanup-only pull request, update it with current main, and merge it before changing PR #633's base.

red.expected: PR #633 still targets cleanup/remove-stale-artifacts and the cleanup branch is not contained in main.

green.expected: Current main contains the cleanup branch and the cleanup pull request has no topology implementation.

tasks.title: Rebase and retarget PR #633 onto main
tasks.scope: Rebase the topology branch onto the resulting main, retarget PR #633 to main, and reject cleanup-only changes in its diff.

red.expected: Fails while the PR base is not main, current main is not an ancestor, or changed paths exceed the task scopes.

green.expected: The GitHub event, local Git graph, exact head, and changed-path policy agree.

tasks.title: Generate the installed operation registry from the canonical registry
tasks.scope: Delete the second operation-ID authority. Generate one registry artifact from CanonicalOperationDefinitions and copy its bytes into the installed product.

red.expected: Fails because GenerateControlMetadataTask reconstructs an eleven-operation document.

green.expected: Generated, staged, and kast --schema operation sets are duplicate-free and exactly equal to the twelve PR #633 operation IDs.

tasks.title: Model topology prerequisite and required traversal incompleteness
tasks.scope: Preserve selector staleness, topology eligibility, bounded incompleteness, and traversal contract violations as different closed states. Keep topology construction and publication outside change.plan and traversal.run.

red.expected: Missing or stale topology still collapses into a generic prerequisite, selector staleness, or plan rejection.

green.expected: Focused fixtures map each prerequisite to one public state; bytecode reachability proves planning and snapshot traversal cannot acquire topology construction or publication authority.

tasks.title: Prove the complete installed topology lifecycle
tasks.scope: Run publish, reuse, traversal, restart, mutation, stale-snapshot rejection, rebuild, and new-generation traversal through the installed product. Re-resolve the traversal subject after mutation before testing stale topology.

red.expected: The installed journey reaches change.plan before topology exists or cannot prove reuse, restart, invalidation, and rebuild.

green.expected: One structured report proves the full installed sequence, while focused store and bytecode gates reject incomplete, corrupt, or hidden-K2 paths.

tasks.title: Remove zero-budget graph algorithms from the stable contract
outputs: stable snapshot/build contract without broad graph algorithms
tasks.scope: Keep current graph algorithms internal to :topology:service. Do not publish traversal, reachability, elementary cycles, SCC, condensation, or quotient until each has a bounded operation contract.

red.expected: Fails because :topology:contract exports zero-budget graph operations.

green.expected: The checked ABI contains snapshot and build contracts only; service algorithms remain internal and no topology read operation is added.

tasks.scope: Remove every remaining eleven-operation or implicit-topology statement from the public and supplied normative authorities.

red.expected: Fails while any authority names eleven operations, an old head, implicit change planning, or broad graph-read API.

green.expected: Generated CLI reference, public docs, and clean-slate authorities agree with the exact twelve-operation program.

tasks.title: Run the clean merge-candidate gate
inputs: all prior gate reports bound to one head
tasks.scope: Run all topology, runtime-delivery, test, architecture, repository-shape, generated-doc, public-doc, and diff checks from a clean checkout.

red.expected: Fails if any prerequisite report is absent, stale, or red.

green.expected: The aggregate report binds every required check to the exact local head.

tasks.title: Require exact-head CI green
outputs: GATE-070 exact-head CI report and workflow artifact
tasks.scope: Reuse the immutable GATE-060 artifact and verify the completed merge-candidate check for github.event.pull_request.head.sha. Do not rebuild, package, install, or rerun the installed lifecycle.

red.expected: The current PR head has no successful required merge-candidate check.

green.expected: CI evidence names the same SHA as PR #633 and has a successful conclusion.

topology.path.scope: exact source selector to exact target selector
rules: Use deterministic BFS with canonical adjacency ordering.
Return Unreachable only after the frontier is exhausted.
Return Qualified on every depth, visited, work, time, or byte bound.
Do not access K2, IntelliJ, Gradle, filesystem traversal, or topology publication.

inputs: TopologyCondensationBudget(maximumSymbols, maximumEdges, maximumComponents, maximumOutputEdges, workUnits, elapsedTime, returnedBytes)
rules: Admit snapshot cardinality before algorithm execution.
Return SCCs, condensation edges, and topological order from one operation.
Return at most one deterministic cycle witness per cyclic component.
Do not add a separate SCC operation.

topology.quotient.scope: repository snapshot projected to one ownership level
rules: Bind continuation to root, generation, topology digest, normalized query fingerprint, level, edge selection, and ordering.
Reject a continuation from another generation or digest.
Use keyset continuation, not an unbound offset.
